units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:12:1">Koh. R. to V, 12</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01016"><he>כָּפִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1:14">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ</cite> top <he>בגין דאנא ת׳ ואנא וכ׳</he> because I am feeble (old), and I become drowsy when reading the Sh’mʿa &c. Ib. V, 9ᵈ top <he>כד הוה ת׳ וכ׳</he> when he felt too weak (to pronounce the priestly benediction), he tied his head up &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:11">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>סלקון … דהוה ת׳</he> they went to visit R. A., who was sick.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:8:3">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵈ</cite> top <he>שמע דר׳ חנינא ת׳</he> heard that R. H. was sick; a. e.—Pl. <he>תַּשִּׁישִׁין</he>, <cite ref="V01090"><he>תַּשִּׁישִׁי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:8">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>מה תורי … ת׳</he> how are the oxen? Said he, they are sick; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16:3">Cant. R. to V, 16</cite> <he>לתשישין</he>, read: <he>לתְשׁוּשִׁין</he>, v. <cite ref="V01110"><he>תָּשַׁשׁ</he></cite>.]
